title: X$^2$Localizer: Cross-grained Alignment for Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization
abstract: arXiv:2608.16658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-view Video Geo-localization (CVG) aims to localize ground-view videos by retrieving their corresponding geo-tagged aerial images. However, CVG approaches rely on fixed-length inputs and post-hoc refinement, hindering online-oriented localization under partial or dynamic observations. In this work, we formulate Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization (PCVG) as a deployment-oriented extension and evaluation protocol of CVG, enabling localization under varying temporal budgets, prefix-based inference, random-start evaluation, and long-range localization with interruptions. To explore PCVG, we introduce X$^2$Localizer, a cross-grained alignment framework that jointly supervises global prefix-to-aerial retrieval and token-aggregated frame--aerial-tile matching with a budget-dependent asymmetric objective. translated_title: X²Localizer：跨粒度对齐用于渐进式跨视角视频地理定位
translated_abstract: 跨视角视频地理定位（CVG）旨在通过检索对应的地理标记航空图像来定位地面视角视频。然而，CVG方法依赖于固定长度的输入和事后细化，这阻碍了在部分或动态观测下的在线定位。在本工作中，我们将渐进式跨视角视频地理定位（PCVG）形式化为CVG的部署导向扩展和评估协议，使其能够在不同的时间预算、基于前缀的推理、随机起始评估以及带中断的长距离定位下实现定位。为了探索PCVG，我们引入了X²Localizer，一种跨粒度对齐框架，该框架联合监督全局前缀到航空检索和令牌聚合的帧-航空瓦片匹配，并采用依赖预算的不对称目标。此外，我们引入了一种滑动窗口重新定位（SWRL）策略，该策略动态刷新候选区域以促进进一步定位。
tldr: 本文提出了X²Localizer，一种用于渐进式跨视角视频地理定位的跨粒度对齐框架，通过全局前缀检索和帧-航空瓦片匹配，结合滑动窗口重新定位策略，实现了在动态观测下的在线定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes X²Localizer, a cross-grained alignment framework for progressive cross-view video geo-localization, enabling online localization under dynamic observations via global prefix retrieval and frame-aerial-tile matching with a sliding-window re-localization strategy.
